historical_record.description: Visitacion Valley Elementary School was rebuilt here in reinforced concrete for $250,000 with Public Works Administration funding, replacing the wood-frame schoolhouse of 1911. G. Albert Lansburgh and Hyman & Appleton designed it in the PWA Moderne style with terra cotta ornament: academic building 1935, auditorium 1937, kindergarten building 1939.
Visitation Valley Elementary School, designed by Abraham Appleton.
Recommended for city landmark designation in 2023, on historical, aesthetic and artistic grounds.
